release_name: Updates that actually reload; location that refreshes
notes: Promotes beta v27.6.14 and v27.6.15. (1) THE RELOAD AFTER AN UPDATE WAS A NO-OP: location.replace() to a URL identical to the current one does not reload, so even a completely successful update left the user on the old page with the update banner still showing - the exact symptom updating is meant to clear. It now reloads when there is no query string to drop. (2) A controllerchange arriving after the 6-second deadline used to do nothing, because forceUpdate had already returned; the reload is now driven by the event itself, 6s only shows a slow-update hint, there is a real 60s give-up that leaves the app able to retry, a rejected update is reported rather than swallowed, and repeated taps cannot arm duplicate listeners. (3) SKIP_WAITING is now held until the new worker reports installed - posting it to a worker that is still installing could be dropped, leaving it waiting forever with no controllerchange. (4) Geolocation: the watchdog retires the request id so a late callback can no longer drag the user back into Near me, and tapping Near me or Retry re-acquires the position instead of reusing the first fix of the session, which meant someone travelling across the island was still sorted by where they started. No data change: 426 rows, 121 sites.
